summary: All 8 Sisters-arc retell episodes (our 32-39 = Railgun S 8-15) promoted to exact per-episode records with page-level splits, from two independent sources that agree everywhere: the toarumajutsunoindex fandom wiki (episode-side 'Adapted From' + chapter-side 'Adapted To' reverse map, fetched via MediaWiki API) and AstroNerdBoy's contemporaneous 2013 episode reviews (page-count detail). The zone is NOT chs 27-39 as stored: it is ch 25 (tail) through ch 37, with ch 37 ('August 21, Part 5') interleaved as fragments across eps 35/36/37/39, plus Index light-novel vol 3 material (Touma/Accelerator side) in eps 35-39; chs 38-39 belong to ep 40 (S16), confirmed by both sources. Grafts: eps 41/46/47 are confirmed annotation-only — each borrows a single scene (ep 41: 4-page cookie scene from the vol-7 special chapter after ch 39 'The Iron Bridge is a Sign of Love' + the ch-40 rat scene (altered) + vol-5 omake 4-koma; ep 46: ch 43 ITEM pool scene only; ep 47: ch 44 Aoki scene only), and real anchors there would double-count chs 43/44 against the existing ep 49/50 anchors and misplace the reader. Ep 41's annotation should add the vol-7 special (39.5) alongside ch 40.

zone_level_only.best_bound: Annotation-only CONFIRMED — no anchor warranted. S ep 17 'Study Group' is anime-original; borrowed content is exactly: (1) 4 pages of the vol-7 SPECIAL chapter 'The Iron Bridge is a Sign of Love' (Sisters Arc epilogue printed between chs 39 and 40; the Mikoto/Saten cookie-making scene — fandom lists it as 'Chapter 039 special', ANB counts the same 4 pages as 'chapter 39'), (2) the ch-40 rat-buying scene, slightly altered (fandom ch-40 page: 'rat buying scene only, though slightly altered'; ANB is weaker: 'very similar to chapter 40 ... but I won't say that's an adaptation'), (3) the Kuroko/Frenda argument from two vol-5 omake 4-koma strips (both sources; matches batch-14's Moegirl finding). An anchor at end=40 would falsely advance the reader past ch 40, which the ep-49 abridged annotation already handles (read 40-42 before T1).

Ch 43's real adaptation is Railgun T ep 1 (our ep 49, already anchored with 43 in its chapters list) — an anchor here would double-count it and misplace the reader.

annotation_updates.note: Corrected zone facts: the Sisters retell zone for eps 32-39 spans ch 25 (tail) through ch 37 — NOT 27-39 as stored. Chs 38-39 belong to ep 40 (S16; fandom ch-38/39 reverse maps list E16 only for the mainline content, and ANB S16: 'This episode adapts original manga chapters 38 & 39 from volume 7'). Ch 37 ('August 21, Part 5', the Touma/Mikoto bridge chapter) is interleaved as fragments across eps 35, 36, 37 and 39 rather than adapted in one place. The Index-side material is Index light novel vol 3 (Touma/Accelerator side, restaging Index anime eps 10-14 scenes), present in eps 35-39; noted, not chapter-numbered, per the manga-only mapping.

Refined: the graft set is the vol-7 SPECIAL chapter after ch 39 ('The Iron Bridge is a Sign of Love', Sisters Arc epilogue — the 4-page Mikoto/Saten cookie scene; this is Moegirl's 'vol-7 extra chapter') PLUS the ch-40 rat-buying scene (slightly altered), plus vol-5 omake 4-koma (Kuroko/Frenda argument). Fandom's ch-39 page reverse-lists E17 only because of this special; the mainline ch 39 content is all in ep 40.

flags_for_sean: ep 40 rollup anchor {18-39, start 18} now double-covers chs 25-37 with the new exact records for eps 32-39. Its true per-episode content is chs 38-39 only (fandom ch-38/39 reverse maps -> E16; ANB S16 review: 'adapts original manga chapters 38 & 39 from volume 7'; the cookie-epilogue special was deferred to ep 41). I did NOT file a repair because narrowing it to {38-39, start 38} would orphan chs 18-25: eps 26-31 (S02-S07, incl. the ep-31 filler row) have no per-episode anchors, and the rollup is currently their only coverage. Recommend a follow-up work-list for eps 26-31 (fandom ch-025 reverse map already shows 25 -> S06/S07/S08), then narrow ep 40. https://toarumajutsunoindex.fandom.com/wiki/Toaru_Kagaku_no_Railgun_Manga_Chapter_038 / https://anime.astronerdboy.com/2013/07/a-certain-scientific-railgun-s-16.html

Eps 41/46/47 verdict: annotation-only confirmed (no anchors filed). Real records at end=40/43/44 would misplace the reader — chs 43/44 are substantively adapted at our eps 49/50 (already in those anchors' chapters lists) and ch 40 is handled by ep 49's abridged annotation (read 40-42 before T1). The updated ep-41 annotation adds the vol-7 special (39.5) to the graft set.

Minor source discrepancies, resolved: fandom ch-034 page omits E14 in its reverse map (ep-side field + ANB both credit ep 38 with ch 34's second half); ANB's S14 review says 'volume five' for chs 34-35 (slip — vol 6 per fandom infoboxes and our stored boundaries); ANB S12 doesn't mention the ch-37 fragment that fandom lists in both directions for ep 36.
